relations.name: crm_record
relations.semantics: CRM account row as observed in crm.csv.

relations.name: invoice_record
relations.semantics: Billing invoice as observed in invoices.json.
relations.construction_rule: Parse invoices.json; referent invoice:<invoice_id>; expose invoice_id as label suffix.

relations.name: registry_record
relations.semantics: Company registry row as observed in company_registry.csv.

relations.name: contract_record
relations.semantics: Contract header fields extracted from markdown sources.
relations.construction_rule: Parse contract markdown headers; referent contract:<basename without .md>.

relations.name: contract_clause
relations.semantics: Typed clause present in a contract document.
relations.construction_rule: Enumerate clause kinds from explicit contract language.

relations.name: contract_term_kind
relations.semantics: Commercial term structure of a contract (rolling, auto-renewal, expired).
relations.construction_rule: Classify term text into rolling_term, auto_renewal, or expired_fixed.

relations.name: contract_active
relations.semantics: Whether a contract is active on the evaluation date from explicit dates and term text.
relations.construction_rule: Expired SOW with past expiry_date is inactive; rolling and renewing MSAs are active.

relations.name: crm_to_billing_candidate
relations.semantics: Candidate link between CRM account and invoice billed-name identity within one commercial cluster.
relations.grounding_contract: Mechanical pairing by domain or commercial_notes cluster
relations.construction_rule: Emit one candidate per CRM account to its cluster billing referent billing:<billed_name>.

relations.name: billing_to_registry_candidate
relations.semantics: Candidate link between billed name and registry row sharing normalized tokens.
relations.construction_rule: Pair billing referent to registry rows with compatible normalized legal names.

relations.name: counterparty_to_contract_candidate
relations.semantics: Candidate association between a counterparty referent and a contract counterparty string.
relations.construction_rule: Pair billing or crm referent to contract when normalized names align within cluster.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.semantics: Resolved epistemic judgment for a candidate identity pair.
relations.grounding_contract: Evidence packet from sources and commercial_notes
relations.construction_rule: Resolve each candidate pair to SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two referents denote the same legal counterparty.

relations.name: acquisition_relevant_clause
relations.semantics: Contract clause kinds that meet Purpose A acquisition-relevance criteria.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over contract_clause with Purpose A policy
relations.construction_rule: Filter WORLD clause kinds to coc consent/termination and assignment notice/consent/competitor restriction.

relations.name: invoice_contract_link
relations.semantics: Purpose A association between invoice and governing active contract.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over identity and contract candidates
relations.construction_rule: Join invoice billed name to contract via SAME_ENTITY chain; association asserted or unresolved.

relations.name: purpose_a_invoice
relations.semantics: Qualifying invoices for contractual revenue exposure.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over invoice_contract_link and acquisition_relevant_clause
relations.construction_rule: Active contract with acquisition-relevant clause and resolvable invoice association.

relations.name: purpose_b_link
relations.semantics: Counterparty identity links for Purpose B output.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over identity_judgment on required chains
relations.construction_rule: Emit sorted links connecting crm, billing, contract, registry per cluster.

relations.name: purpose_c_dependency
relations.semantics: Commercial dependency rows for Purpose C.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over active contracts, obligations, open invoices, identity
relations.construction_rule: Dependent when current relationship and obligation kind; unresolved if identity chain breaks.
